title: Making Pancakes
text:
I like to make pancakes on Sunday. First, I mix two eggs, one cup of milk and one cup of flour. Then I add a little sugar. The mixture is thick and smooth.

Next, I heat a pan and put a little butter in it. I pour some mixture into the pan. After one minute, I turn the pancake over. My family eats them with honey.

questions.text: What day does the speaker make pancakes?
What does the speaker's family eat the pancakes with?
What can you guess about the speaker's pancakes from the passage?
options: They are cooked carefully and shared with family
They are cooked in a restaurant

questions.text: Why does the speaker turn the pancake over?
options: So that the other side can cook
So that the pan becomes clean

paragraph_translations: Lubię robić naleśniki w niedzielę. Najpierw mieszam dwa jajka, jedną szklankę mleka i jedną szklankę mąki. Potem dodaję trochę cukru. Masa jest gęsta i gładka.
Następnie rozgrzewam patelnię i wkładam na nią trochę masła. Wlewam trochę masy na patelnię. Po minucie przewracam naleśnik. Moja rodzina zjada je z miodem.
